rules: Use rem-valued minimum and maximum bounds; vw may appear only in the middle clamp() term.
At 1920px, tokens retain the Figma-derived desktop values.
Between 1280px and 2560px, the shell, editorial canvas, type, spacing, radii, components and their internals use the same S coefficient; values reach 133.3333% at 2560px and do not grow further.
A page composition may allocate a component width and position but must not override an owned component aspect ratio or internal geometry.
Width and height of a proportional block derive from the same scale or from one approved aspect ratio; do not give them independent fluid curves.
Minimum 24px content gutters and 48px interaction targets may stop shrinking before the proportional value, but these exceptions must not change card or section aspect ratios.
Technical 1px hairlines, dimensionless line-height, colors, opacity and full-radius are not multiplied by S.

The approved 24px outer gutter, 48px minimum interaction target, semantic source order, hairlines, dimensionless line-height, colors, opacity and full-radius remain explicit exceptions. The composition reconfigures only at 1280px and 768px.
assets: Figma images from 4641:3330 are copied locally into theme assets; the two teacher circles use the supplied local exports Frame 4216.png and Frame 4240.png. The supplied hero videos preview.mp4 and original.mp4 are stored as assets/videos/home/hero-preview.mp4 and hero-original.mp4; the supplied bg-news.png is assets/images/home/news-background.png and bg-form.png is assets/images/home/application-background.png. Remote short-lived MCP URLs are never used in production markup.

layout.grid: Every page uses an editorial content canvas with a minimum 24 px (Space 5) inline gutter from the left navigation rail and from the browser edge. On desktop the canvas is a four-column equal grid with a 16 px (Space 4) gap at the 1920px reference; the gap follows S. Tablet and mobile may recompose the number of columns, but retain the 24 px outer gutter.
layout.page_width: The desktop design target is a 1920px viewport. Inspected 1900px Figma frames are normalized to 1920. From 1280 through 2560, proportional desktop values use S = viewportWidth / 1920 clamped to 0.666667–1.333333; beyond 2560 the composition is centred and no longer grows.
layout.section_rhythm: Major editorial blocks use the 1920px reference rhythm scaled with S across desktop; internal component and subsection spacing follows the same S unless an explicit minimum is documented.
layout.density: Spacious marketing sections with denser data tables for news, scores and achievements.
responsive_rules: Use exactly three global layout modes: mobile 320–767, tablet 768–1279, desktop 1280–2560+.
Keep html font-size at 100%; do not implement global viewport scaling through the root font size.
Use rem for type, spacing, component size and radius. Use vw only as the fluid term of reviewed clamp() tokens.
On desktop use S = clamp(0.666667, viewportWidth / 1920, 1.333333) for the whole composition; shell, canvas, sections, components and internals must not use competing envelopes.
A page owns placement and available width; owned components keep their approved aspect ratio and internal geometry.

Tablet reuse gate: before styling a new tablet page, select an accepted reference page with the same shell or component and reuse its documented token scope. At 1279px and 768px, matching compositions must have equal computed Sidebar, Footer and editorial-canvas rectangles plus equal shared DataTable/Card grid tracks and ratios; fix a mismatch in the shared scope or component, never with a page-level geometry override.
Minimum 24px gutters and 48px interaction targets, 1px hairlines, dimensionless line-height, full-radius, colors and opacity are explicit non-scaling exceptions.
Media queries use px and 1px is allowed for hairline borders.
Components may recompose at 1280 and 768; mobile is not a uniformly shrunken desktop.
Do not add global breakpoints without updating this manifest first.
Support 320px without horizontal page scrolling and without clipping text.
Above 2560px, full-bleed backgrounds may extend but content and typography do not continue growing.

Hover is a desktop-only interaction state: at 1280px and wider, approved pointer-hover feedback remains available; at tablet and mobile widths (320–1279px), hover must not alter color, opacity, transform, scale, surface or text position. Those modes retain default, active/pressed and keyboard :focus-visible states, and roll-based links must render their primary label in the default visible position.

rules: Stories import the production entrypoint and must not duplicate production tokens or component styles.
Story-only CSS may arrange and label specimens but may not redefine visual token values.
Accessibility checks fail on violations; local Playwright screenshots are the visual baseline and do not require a cloud service.

Every production component story provides a typed Playground with args and argTypes for meaningful public properties; static Variants and States remain deterministic visual baselines with Controls disabled.
ApplicationForm additionally provides an Interactive Storybook demo: it validates locally, shows submitting and success states, and never sends personal data or requests the production endpoint.
Every production-component change updates its Storybook story and relevant checks, then rebuilds the published staging Storybook before completion.
The home page has page-level geometry and visual-regression coverage at 1280, 1920 and 2560px plus proportional smoke checks at 1440, 1600 and 2240px.
Desktop fluid checks assert approved aspect ratios and coherent relative scaling of the outer block and its internals; isolated component tests are insufficient when page composition adds overrides.
storybook.font_validation: Playwright waits for the F37 Ginger Cyrillic VF FontFace to reach loaded status before axe or screenshot assertions.

visual_language.mood: Warm, confident and contemporary editorial identity: youthful without childish decoration, institutional without bureaucracy.
composition_rules: Use the green brand accent sparingly against white and near-black surfaces.
Use large photography and typographic hierarchy as primary visual devices.
Use a soft green-to-dark atmospheric gradient only in approved hero and application contexts.
Keep data-heavy sections flat, aligned and readable; use rules rather than nested cards.
Preserve generous whitespace between major sections.
imagery_rules: Prioritise authentic photographs of the choir, performances, teachers and community.
Never distort or arbitrarily crop faces; define focal points where supported.
Use approved aspect ratios per MediaCard variant and responsive mode.
Do not upscale weak migration assets without review.
iconography_rules: Use the existing simple monochrome icon language and the approved category mapping.
Social icons may be editor-managed SVG only after sanitisation.
Icons supplement labels and must not be the only accessible name.
motion_rules: PageHero title reveal, the approved Home Hero title reveal, Hero preview hover feedback, Home teacher CTA arrow hover feedback and Teacher card text roll hover feedback may animate. Teacher card hover rolls the surname and given-name line vertically using duration-link-roll and easing-link-roll, and scales only the portrait inside its fixed 160×160 clipping container to 110% using duration-media-card-hover and easing-media-card-hover. Card geometry remains fixed.
The muted looping Home Hero preview is the only approved autoplay media; do not add other autoplay media or continuous ornamental motion.
Do not use an operating-system motion-preference media feature or JavaScript check.
anti_patterns: Unowned accent colors or new gradients
Arbitrary type sizes or spacing outside tokens
Desktop scaled down uniformly for mobile
Competing fluid envelopes inside one block
aspect-ratio:auto on a component with an approved ratio
Independent fluid width and height for a proportional block
Page selectors that silently redefine owned component geometry
Mechanical px-to-rem replacement presented as responsive scaling
Viewport-specific correction without checking the complete desktop matrix

accessibility.contrast_policy: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for text and meaningful controls. Validate the green/white and secondary-text combinations before release.
accessibility.keyboard_policy: All navigation, filters, accordions, galleries and forms must work by keyboard in a logical DOM order.
accessibility.focus_policy: Every interactive element has a visible :focus-visible style not dependent on hover. Focus styling is a required design-system gap to resolve.
accessibility.system_motion_policy: Approved motion works identically regardless of the operating system's motion preference; do not implement an alternate reduced-motion branch.

governance.token_policy: Use semantic CSS custom properties backed by this manifest. Desktop geometry tokens derive from the shared S contract; raw values and independent fluid envelopes are allowed only while defining a documented exception, not at call sites.
governance.component_policy: Reuse an owned component before creating a local variant. Pages own placement and available width but not owned aspect ratios or internal geometry. Every interactive component ships with applicable states, responsive behaviour, Storybook parity and page-level checks where composition can override it.
governance.when_to_add_new_tokens: Add a token when a new semantic role is approved or a value repeats across at least two owned components. Document source and intended role.
governance.when_to_add_new_components: Add a component for repeated structure or behaviour with a stable API. One-off page composition remains a section, not a universal component.

open_questions: Design and approve tablet and mobile typography, layout, navigation and all component variants.
Audit hard-coded Figma spacing values and complete the spacing scale before implementation.
Design focus-visible, active, disabled, loading and error states missing from the component boards.
Confirm the legal consent control and copy for the application form.
Confirm the category icon mapping for news, announcements and achievements.
Review color contrast for green with white text, secondary text and thin borders.
